parser_review: Every nonempty Link entry now requires relation metadata, so absent or malformed relations cannot claim collection completion.
General extension parameters may be bare tokens; relation values must be registered-style names or quoted absolute-URI relation types.
Quoted parameter delimiters and escaped characters continue through the unchanged field splitter.
Any anchor context is explicitly refused because this client does not resolve alternate link contexts.
Target URL admission, initial-origin checks, equivalent-origin cycle identity, query encoding, collection validation and broker envelope handling retain every parent source byte.
test_scope: Eleven selected controls per mode, run in isolated frozen copies with explicit PYTHONPATH. Broker controls traverse local HTTP and the native client decoder; token controls use native httpx with synthetic MockTransport. These receipts are not a browser or live Canvas claim.
